title: Voice control
triggerHint: Say an appointment, task or reading
textPlaceholder: For example: appointment physio tomorrow at 10 am

examples.title: You can say:
examples.list: What appointments do I have today?
examples.task: New task: pick up prescription by Friday
examples.done: Task pick up prescription is done

confirm.localAi: The date or time was read by the local language model. Please check it.

errors.generic: Sorry, that did not work. Please try again.
errors.notUnderstood: Sorry, I did not understand: "{{text}}". Please use one of the examples.
errors.empty: I did not hear anything. Please try again.
errors.tooLong: The recording is too long. Please say a short command.
errors.micDenied: The microphone is not allowed. You can type the command instead.
errors.WHISPER_NOT_CONFIGURED: Speech recognition is not available right now. You can type the command.
errors.NOT_ALLOWED: Your access does not allow this.
errors.TASK_NOT_FOUND: I found no open task with that name.
errors.TASK_REQUIRED: Please say which task is done.
errors.VALUE_OUT_OF_RANGE: This value is unusual. Please check it.
errors.UNKNOWN_INTENT: I do not know this command.
